Product: Quick OKR milestone check — Q1 rollout items. What shipped, what's slipped, blockers, and who owns next steps? Ping eng/runtime + eng-platform. Can leads reply with 1-2 lines per item? TL;DR for exec sync. @mike @julia

Mike: Runtime — rolled `rolling-kv-cache` to prod last night. Observed +18% throughput on p99 path. No outstanding CRs. /cc @sam for perf numbers :tada:

Sam: Perf followups — seeing a regression on long-seq requests after rotation; opened PR #428 with a revert patch. Needs review from runtime. @Anne can you prioritize CR?

Anne: On it, will review PR #428 today. If safe, merge by noon PST. :thumbsup:

Julia: Platform — Dedicated autoscale policy changes slipped. Infra approval took longer than expected. New ETA: Wed EOD. Owners: @Julia (platform), @Ken (infra).

Ken: Infra — HSM/KMS onboarding for Private deployments blocked by a compliance question. Eng-security requested an architecture doc; I'm drafting and will file in #security-reqs.

Product: For shipped items, can we get one-line user-visible release notes? Mike — can you draft?

Mike: Release note draft: "KV prefix caching reduces tail latency and token cost for sequences >512" — will refine if product wants wording changed.

Sam: CR ping to @Anne sent. Also adding an integration test for rotation edge-cases to the runtime board (ticket ENG-541).

Anne: ACK. Adding test now, ETA tomorrow morning.

Product: For slipped autoscale, what's mitigation for Dedicated customers in the meantime?

Julia: Temporary mitigation — manual capacity reservations and scheduled scaling windows. I'll create a short runbook and assign SRE on-call.

Ken: Also adding a console alert and admin flag to force extra capacity. Filing ticket INF-773.

Deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: rolling-kv-cache v1.3 -> prod @ 1719058888

Sam: Noted a flaky CI test for autoscale; labeled flaky and created ticket #991 to triage.

Product: Final ask before exec: owners + one next action (who will do what by when). I'll compile. Please reply with exactly: "Owner — action — due"

Mike — draft release note — today EOD
Anne — review PR #428 — today noon PST
Julia — create runbook + assign SRE — tomorrow 10:00am PT
Ken — finish HSM doc & respond to security — Tue EOD
Sam — add integration test & ticket — tomorrow morning

Product: Thanks all — compiling into the OKR milestone snapshot now. :pray:
